# Inert official socket source fixtures

These unmodified `.source` files are data for source-analysis tests. They come
from the official CPython 3.13.12 release archive, SHA-256
`2a84cd31dd8d8ea8aaff75de66fc1b4b0127dd5799aa50a64ae9a313885b4593`.
Tests do not import or compile them. The upstream license is included as `LICENSE`.
Exact file sizes and SHA-256 pins are recorded in the fixed runtime closure.
